span.term: Achievement tests additionally require locating the mathematical problem inside a verbal or visual description and building a problem representation, and working memory maintains and manipulates that representation - which is why a direct working-memory path survives beyond the component skills
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Working memory activates and retrieves number facts from long-term memory while inhibition suppresses the neighbouring but incorrect answers that are co-activated during retrieval
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Conceptual information is stored in a verbal code whereas arithmetic facts also carry a visuospatial component from how sums are presented and encoded, so only verbal working memory supports conceptual retrieval while both domains support fact retrieval
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: updating → executive functions
span.note: A CUE-LIST GAP, NOT A VOCABULARY GAP - `part-of` IS THE RIGHT TYPE. `Executive functions ... Quotation withheld These are (i) UPDATING or working memory ...` The gate refused it because its containment cue list holds `within / part of / comprises / consists of / includes / belongs to` and not `DIVIDED INTO`. Measured over all 711 staged bodies: **`composed of` 262 occurrences in 151 bodies and `divided into` 201 in 137 - each MORE COMMON than `comprises` (68 in 51), which IS in the list**; also `made up of` 28 and `subdivided into` 17. **I could have passed this edge by omitting `relation_evidence`, because the type-specific cue test only fires when that field is supplied - which is Q-930's shape, and the fact that I can is not a reason to.** The edge is filed here until the cue list is amended by whoever owns the gate, and should be promoted to `part-of` when it is. Note also that this record was MISSING the third Miyake component entirely: it carried `inhibition` and `shifting` and not `updating`. terminal-a, 2026-08-26.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: executive functions - AS DIVIDED HERE: three components following Miyake et al. (2000) — updating or working memory, inhibition, and shifting
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: working memory - the Baddeley and Hitch (1974) model, described as adopted by the MAJORITY of researchers in the field rather than as established
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `updating` / `working memory` - AN ALIAS ASSERTED BY A BARE `OR`, AND IT IS THE LOOSEST JOIN IN THIS PAPER. `These are (i) UPDATING OR WORKING MEMORY, the ability to monitor and manipulate information held in mind`. Miyake's component is `updating`; `working memory` is a much older and much broader term that this sentence quietly equates with it. **The paper's own later sections then distinguish VERBAL from VISUOSPATIAL working memory and report they behave differently** - a distinction `updating` does not carry. The `or` does more work than it admits.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `executive functions` - DEFINED BY WHAT THEY ARE FOR, THEN IMMEDIATELY BY A THREE-WAY PARTITION. `EXECUTIVE FUNCTIONS, THE SKILLS USED TO GUIDE AND CONTROL THOUGHT AND ACTION, Quotation withheld` The functional gloss is the paper's own; the partition is attributed, and `typically` marks it as convention rather than fact. **Each component then gets a one-clause definition in the same sentence** - updating, inhibition, shifting - so the whole construct is fixed in 60 words.

span.label: The domain-specific skills of factual knowledge, procedural skill and conceptual understanding only partially mediated the executive-function/achievement link, with numerical inhibitory control acting on achievement through factual knowledge and procedural skill.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Executive function measures explained far more variance in overall mathematics achievement (34%) than in any single component skill, and least of all in conceptual understanding (5%).
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Verbal working memory uniquely predicted all four outcomes - factual knowledge, procedural skill, conceptual understanding and mathematics achievement.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Set shifting and non-numerical (animal-size Stroop) inhibition predicted nothing once working memory was in the model, whereas numerical inhibition uniquely predicted factual knowledge and procedural skill.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Contrary to the prediction that executive demands would fall as procedures automatise, the strength of the executive-function/mathematics relationships did not change between 8 years and adulthood.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Beyond the indirect routes through the component skills, working memory retained a large direct path to mathematics achievement.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Verbal working memory influenced achievement indirectly through all three component skills, with the procedural-skill route the largest of the three indirect paths.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The predicted association of inhibition and shifting with overall mathematics achievement failed to appear when working memory was included in the same model.
